title: MD simulation of glass formation
action: For each of the three compositions (Cu50Zr50, Cu45Zr45Ag10, Cu40Zr40Ag20), set up an MD simulation of approximately 250 atoms in a cubic box with periodic boundary conditions. Melt at 2500 K for 2000 steps (5 fs per step), quench to 300 K at a cooling rate of ~4×10¹³ K·s⁻¹, and relax. Use an open-source ab initio MD code (e.g., CP2K) or a validated classical potential. Save the final relaxed atomic configurations.
description: Generates the three glass models needed for analysis.

title: Compute EXAFS spectra
action: From the final atomic configurations of step_0, calculate EXAFS k²χ(k) for the Cu K, Zr K, and Ag K edges using FEFF8/9. Generate spectra for each composition and edge, covering the k range ~2–12 Å⁻¹.
description: EXAFS spectra for Cu50Zr50, Cu45Zr45Ag10, Cu40Zr40Ag20 at Cu-K, Zr-K, and Ag-K edges.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: Cu50Zr50_Cu_K, Cu50Zr50_Zr_K, Cu45Zr45Ag10_Cu_K, Cu45Zr45Ag10_Zr_K, Cu45Zr45Ag10_Ag_K, Cu40Zr40Ag20_Cu_K, Cu40Zr40Ag20_Zr_K, Cu40Zr40Ag20_Ag_K. Each value contains arrays 'k' (float, Å⁻¹) and 'chi' (float, dimensionless).

title: Voronoi tessellation analysis
action: Perform Voronoi tessellation on the final atomic configurations from step_0 to identify topological short-range order. For each composition and for each center type (Cu, Zr, Ag), compute the fraction of each Voronoi index among the polyhedra.
description: Voronoi polyhedra fractions for each composition and center type.
output_schema: CSV with columns: composition (str, e.g., 'Cu50Zr50'), center_type (str, one of 'Cu','Zr','Ag'), voronoi_index (str, e.g., '<0 2 8 1>'), fraction (float between 0 and 1). List all center types and dominant indices per composition.

title: Ag–Ag coordination numbers
action: From the Voronoi neighbor analysis, compute the average number of Ag nearest neighbors for each Ag atom (Ag–Ag coordination). Report the result for Cu45Zr45Ag10 and Cu40Zr40Ag20.
description: Average number of Ag nearest neighbors for each Ag atom in Ag-containing alloys.
output_schema: JSON object with keys 'Cu45Zr45Ag10' and 'Cu40Zr40Ag20'. Each value is a float representing the average Ag–Ag coordination number.
